messages:
Maya: Quick sync  planning a 10% canary for model v3.0-int8-lite at 01:00 PT across enterprise-search + consumer-chat. Need final sequential-A/B gating rules (we want alpha spending to avoid noisy early stops).

Sam: Paste the proposed gate when you have it.

Maya: Draft gate below. Focus: avoid quality regressions, be tolerant to tiny latency blips but strict on embed drift and rerank fidelity.

```yaml
canary_percent: 10
eval_window_minutes: 10
check_interval_minutes: 2
min_samples: 1500
alpha: 0.02   # overall Type I budget
alpha_spend_strategy: "oca-sequential"  # small spends per window
consecutive_fail_windows: 3
metrics:
  composite_threshold: 0.06
  embed_cosine_drop_threshold: 0.04
  embed_cosine_immediate: 0.12  # immediate abort
  p95_latency_multiplier: 1.4
  p99_latency_absolute_ms: 250
cohort_weights:
  enterprise-search: 0.7
  consumer-chat: 0.3
auto_fallback:
  action: route-to-stable
  fallback_scale_to_percent: 2
  notify: ["#incidents","@oncall"]
quality_tests:
  - paired-bootstrap: true
  - rerank-stability: top5-preservation
warmup_checks:
  kv_prefix_warm: min_successful=5 within_first_8m
  deterministic_seed_check: true
logging:
  sample_rate: 0.15  # fraction of requests to capture full context
```

Ravi: Two thoughts: 1) use paired sequential test with early-stopping only if p<0.001 early, otherwise keep alpha-spend conservative. 2) require min_samples per-cohort (e.g., enterprise min 900) so skewed traffic doesn't hide regressions.

Tess: Add small deterministic rerank window: run top-10 rerank on a seeded set every 5m and assert top-1 stability >= 0.92, otherwise flag. That helps catch reorder regressions that embedding metrics miss.

eval-bot: Shadow run (45m): samples_total=1,820; enterprise=1,080; consumer=740; composite_delta=0.025; embed_cosine_drop=0.031; rerank_top1_stability=0.94; p95=130ms (baseline p95=115ms); p99=210ms; paired_pval=0.038. Warmup_kv=ok.

Sam: Paired_pval 0.038 > 0.02 so not significant yet. p95 elevated but within multiplier 1.4 (130/115=1.13). Looks safe for now.

Ravi: Agree. But watch enterprise fold: if enterprise pval < 0.02 we should act even if global pval is > threshold. Suggest enterprise_min_samples=900 as mentioned.

Maya: Adding enterprise_min_samples=900 and explicit enterprise alpha share 0.7. Also note immediate embed_cosine_immediate=0.12 is our emergency short-circuit.

Tess: Ops request: when fallback occurs capture 500 samples with full KV dump and annotate whether prefix warming completed. Also tag traces with canary_id.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled at 01:00 PT. API call: POST /rollouts {model:v3.0-int8-lite, split:10, slices:[enterprise-search,consumer-chat]}

Maya: Final decision summary: alpha=0.02 with OCA sequential spend, min_samples=1500 global (enterprise min 900), consecutive_fail_windows=3, embed_immediate=0.12, fallback scale-to-2%, paired-bootstrap testing, rerank-top1 stability >=0.92 required.

eval-bot: 10m early check: samples=620, composite=0.022, embed_drop=0.02, rerank_top1=0.95, p95_mult=1.18. No stop criteria hit.

Sam: If we see p-value hover near 0.02 but sample sizes low, don't auto-abort; let the sequential alpha spend play out to avoid flip-flopping.

Ravi: We'll also enable a noise-filter: require the composite to exceed threshold by at least 20% of its stddev before counting as a failure window. Helps avoid single-window blips.

Maya: Good, add composite_stddev_margin=0.2 * stddev. I'll update the canary config.

eval-bot: 30m update: total_samples=1,540, composite=0.028, embed_drop=0.035, enterprise_pval=0.019, global_pval=0.031, p95=135ms, p99=225ms. Enterprise pval under 0.02 triggers enterprise-level alert per policy.

ops-bot: Enterprise alert sent to #eng-ml and paging oncall.

Tess: Given enterprise pval < alpha, do we immediate-fallback or do we wait for consecutive windows?

Maya: Policy: enterprise-scoped significance (p<0.02) AND enterprise_min_samples satisfied -> immediate targeted fallback for enterprise slice (route enterprise traffic to stable, reduce canary_percent to 3% global). Full global fallback only if composite threshold or embed_immediate tripped.

Sam: Works. Make sure rollback runbook includes query set + top-10 rerank traces.

Ravi: I'm collecting failing examples now and will put anonymized samples into the incident thread.

ops-bot: Canary adjusted: enterprise routed to stable; canary global now 3%. Monitoring continues.

Maya: Thanks team. Action items: Ravi collect samples, Tess ensure traces tagged and stored, Sam keep an eye on sequential alpha spending, eval-bot keep posting windows. If anything else pops up paste it here.

eval-bot: Ongoing updates will post to this thread every check_interval.

Maya: Closing the loop  nice catch on enterprise signal. We'll reconvene after 24h or earlier if fallback escalates.
